content.general_rule: A person who is involved in placing a product for commercial purpose
content.exception: Does not include a person who leases a product, without having a reasonable opportunity to inspect and discover defects in the product, under a lease arrangement in which the selection, possession, maintenance, and operation of the product are controlled by a person other than the lessor
conditions: acts only in a financial capacity with respect to the sale of the product
is not a manufacturer, wholesaler, distributor, retailer, direct seller or an electronic service provider
